description: This source file 'BridgeObject.cpp' appears to be part of a web browser extension or embedded web environment component. It includes functions for injecting JavaScript code into web pages, handling messages between JavaScript and C++, and managing bridge objects that facilitate communication. The presence of 'WebKitWebPage', 'WebKitFrame', and related WebKit GTK components indicates it is related to a web rendering engine and its extension.

methods.name: CallBridge
methods.description: Handles invoking JavaScript code in the WebKit context to process messages, decoding Base64 payload, and executing scripts within the WebKit JavaScript environment.

methods.name: OnBridgeQuery
methods.description: Sends a message to the web page with a payload, encoding it in Base64, to query or pass data to JavaScript.

methods.name: OnCreateBridgeObject
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript object with a function property that, when called, triggers a message back into the C++ code for further processing.

methods.name: InjectJS
methods.description: Injects JavaScript code into the web page's main frame to set up the service manager and bridge object, enabling communication between C++ and JavaScript.

methods.name: HandleMessageToPage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages from JavaScript based on their message name, calling appropriate handler functions.
